report_name: Chinese Mercenary APT 'Jewelbug' Juggles Espionage and Crypto Theft

threat_actors.name: Jewelbug
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated Chinese hacker-for-hire group that conducts dual-purpose campaigns, including state-level espionage against government and military targets and large-scale cryptocurrency theft, using a unified C2 infrastructure.
threat_actors.goals: Conducting cyber espionage for state interests and financial gain through cryptocurrency theft.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Jewelbug uses phishing for initial access, delivered via SEO-poisoned websites for criminal operations and more targeted spear-phishing for espionage campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Drive-by Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The group uses SEO poisoning to drive traffic to malicious websites, leading to drive-by compromise to install their malware.

attack_patterns.name: User Execution
attack_patterns.description: The attack chain relies on the victim executing a malicious payload, such as installing a malicious application or browser extension.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials from Web Browsers
attack_patterns.description: The Fostealer malware and the 'PDF Viewer' malicious browser extension are used to steal browser cookies and credentials from victims.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Collected data, including credentials, cookies, emails, and cryptocurrency wallet data, is exfiltrated to the 'XG-Web' C2 server.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: Jewelbug transfers its malware suite, including Fostealer and Antino, to compromised systems after initial access.

attack_patterns.name: SEO Poisoning
attack_patterns.description: Jewelbug employs a fleet of servers and bots for SEO poisoning to drive traffic to their thousands of AI-generated phishing websites.

attack_patterns.name: Software Extensions
attack_patterns.description: The group uses a malicious browser extension named 'PDF Viewer' to steal cookies, inject JavaScript, and perform man-in-the-browser attacks.

malware.name: Fostealer
malware.description: A primary implant used by Jewelbug for data exfiltration, capable of stealing cookies, credentials, and emails.

malware.name: Antino
malware.description: A backdoor used by Jewelbug to maintain persistent access to compromised systems.

malware.name: PDF Viewer
malware.description: A malicious browser extension that can inject JavaScript, steal cookies, and perform 'man-in-the-browser' attacks, including silently replacing cryptocurrency wallet addresses during transactions.

tools.name: XG-Web
tools.description: A custom command-and-control panel used by Jewelbug to manage both its espionage and cybercrime campaigns from a unified infrastructure.

identities.name: Asian Government and Military Organizations
identities.description: Government, military, naval, police, and army intelligence bodies in Asia targeted for espionage by Jewelbug.

identities.name: Middle Eastern Government and Telecommunications Organizations
identities.description: Government and state-owned telecommunications organizations in the Middle East targeted for espionage by Jewelbug.

identities.name: U.S. Aerospace Manufacturer
identities.description: A specific but unnamed U.S. aerospace manufacturer targeted by Jewelbug for espionage.

identities.name: Cryptocurrency Users
identities.description: Individual cryptocurrency users targeted by Jewelbug's large-scale theft campaigns.

infrastructure.name: Jewelbug Unified C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A unified command-and-control infrastructure managed by the custom 'XG-Web' panel, used for both espionage and cybercrime operations.

infrastructure.name: Jewelbug Phishing and SEO Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A fleet of servers and bots used for SEO poisoning and hosting thousands of AI-generated phishing websites related to cryptocurrency and betting.

indicators.name: Jewelbug Malware File Detection
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Jewelbug Malware Execution
id: f9a8b7c6-d5e4-4f3a-2b1c-0d9e8f7a6b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of malware associated with the Jewelbug APT group, as identified by process image names.
references:
  - https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/jewelbug-apt-state-espionage-cryptocurrency-theft
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-08-13'
tags:
  - attack.t1204
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\fostealer.exe'
      - '\antino.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of Jewelbug malware components Fostealer and Antino by their filenames.

indicators.name: Suspicious Browser Extension Installation - PDF Viewer
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Browser Extension Installation - PDF Viewer
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files or directories related to a potentially malicious browser extension named 'PDF Viewer', associated with the Jewelbug APT group.
references:
  - https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/jewelbug-apt-state-espionage-cryptocurrency-theft
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-08-13'
tags:
  - attack.t1176.001
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_chrome:
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - '\Extensions'
  selection_edge:
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
      - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data'
      - '\Extensions'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|contains: 'PDF Viewer'
  condition: (selection_chrome or selection_edge) and selection_name
indicators.description: Detects the installation of a suspicious browser extension named 'PDF Viewer', a tool used by the Jewelbug APT.

relationships.target_name: Middle Eastern Government and Telecommunications Organizations
